$comment: Ann Sacks (annsacks.com redirects here) is Kohler's tile brand on a Next.js App Router storefront (self.__next_f, React Server Components) behind Akamai. The product page HTML is a JavaScript shell: no h1, price or gallery in the markup, only <title>, the meta description, a canonical link and a schema.org Product JSON-LD block (name, price, image), which the selectors cannot read. Product URLs are /p/<category>/<slug> (for example /p/trim/savoy-0-5-x-8-box-liner-trim-as11682-trim-boxliner); the site has no sitemap.xml and robots.txt is a default Apache page with no rules. The default User-Agent (ProductExtractor/1.0) is tarpitted (FETCH_TIMEOUT after 93 s, twice) while a Chrome User-Agent gets the page in under 2 s, so fetch.user_agent is a Chrome string. fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM reads the product from the page (including the JSON-LD) and every value is checked against the page; prices are in US dollars. The selectors are a fallback for the http engine and the saved fixture: root is the document, title is <title> (it carries an 'Ann Sacks ' prefix) and description is the meta description; image and price are not in the markup, so the http engine returns PRICE_MISSING. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: FETCH_TIMEOUT with the default User-Agent, and with a Chrome User-Agent only the fallback fields (title, description; no price, image or specs); browser: FETCH_TIMEOUT (headless Chrome, 109 s); duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: SUCCESS with title, price $21.95, image and description at 1,163+321 tokens; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. ai-crawler-avalai is selected: it is the only engine that returns the price and image. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the Savoy 0.5" x 8" Box Liner Trim page on 2026-11-19.
